annotations.title: AI summary of an SEC filing

description: AI summary of an SEC filing — Fetches a company's latest (or n-th latest) SEC filing straight from EDGAR and returns an AI summary: headline, 3-5 sentence summary, key points, the figures quoted in the filing, risks, event type and sentiment. 8-Ks include the Exhibit 99 press release when attached; 10-K/10-Q focus on MD&A. symbol= ticker or CIK, optional form= (8-K default, 10-K, 10-Q, 6-K, 20-F, S-1, DEF 14A) and n= (0 = latest). Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_filing_summary
